name: brutalistBold
title: Brutalist Bold
description: Raw industrial concrete geometry, high-visibility hazard orange and acid lime accents, massive condensed type blocks, and uncompromising mechanical punch.
do: Scale headline typography to extreme, frame-filling proportions
Pair stark high-visibility hazard hues with brutal raw concrete grays
Use instant whip-snaps, hard cuts, and abrupt mechanical kinetic eases
dont: Do not use gentle pastel transitions or romantic serif flourishes
Avoid smooth gradual crossfades when a decisive hard impact fits
Never dilute visual impact with timid, tiny typography
